summary: Wetour Robotics Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a sales agreement with Rodman Renshaw LLC for an at-the-market offering of ordinary shares. The ATM allows issuance and sale of shares from time to time through the sales agent, with commission up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. The offering is registered under an existing Form F-3 shelf registration statement. This is a routine equity financing arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms such as price or premium are specified, and the filing merely discloses the standard ATM mechanics and customary closing conditions.
